\section{Discussion}
The bound is sharp for constant functions.

like "the proof is omitted" does not support a bound. Also propose as followUpSection the exact
title of the section that the next review round should examine (one of: Setup, Main bound, Discussion).
Name the section you checked and set supported accordingly.
